name: nano-erp
description: Composable nano-ERP platform — tenancy core (hierarchical orgs, RLS, Supabase identity mapping)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && cp -R drizzle dist/drizzle
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:compiled
scripts.frontend:verify: npm run frontend:lint && npm run frontend:typecheck && npm run frontend:test && npm run frontend:build
scripts.tokens:check: before="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- design/build)" && npm run tokens:build && after="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- design/build)" && test "$before" = "$after"
scripts.verify:stages: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run db:check && npm run gate:preflight && npm run tokens:check && npm run tokens:lint && npm run frontend:verify && npm run test:compiled
scripts.db:check: drizzle-kit check && before="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- drizzle)" && drizzle-kit generate && after="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- drizzle)" && test "$before" = "$after"
